description: This file defines a helper class 'ConfigReader' for reading configuration entries and performing variable substitution within the Apache Spark project. It includes methods for binding configuration providers, resolving variable references with prefixes (default, system, env), and handling default values.

classes.name: ConfigReader
classes.description: A class for reading configuration entries and performing variable substitution with support for different configuration sources and variable prefixes.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a prefix to a configuration provider.

methods.name: bindEnv
methods.description: Binds the 'env' prefix to an environment variable provider.

methods.name: bindSystem
methods.description: Binds the 'system' prefix to a system properties provider.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key and performs variable substitution.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution on a string, resolving references with prefixes.

methods.name: getOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from a provider, falling back to default values if necessary.
